### Summary
Provide a brief summary of the proposed updates to the existing section. This include new topics, links, or coding assistants that have become relevant to an existing section.
Mention the section title or topic to be augmented.

### Additional References or Resources or Context
If relevant, provide links to external resources, standards, or best practices that support the proposed updates.
